notes.subject: התנשמת
notes.rationale: Strong tok 'hard breather'; ol man i tok em i tarangau (ASV/JPS 'horned owl') o liklik pisin — mi tanim long nois bilong en

notes.subject: הקאת
notes.rationale: Nem i kam long קיא (karim bek / vomit) — pelikan i tingim i karim bek kaikai; mining i lus long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: הרחם
notes.rationale: Strong tok i tok em i kandere i gat marimari long pikinini bilong en; KJV 'gier eagle', JPS 'carrion-vulture'

translation: na ⟨את⟩ pisin i pulim win strong long nait, na ⟨את⟩ pelikan, na ⟨את⟩ kandere i kaikai bodi man i dai pinis
